fields.name: SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionsConfiguration
fields.description: SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionsConfiguration is the SQL Server shard-set configuration shape: it identifies a shard set and its default shard, exposes the configured shard collection, and exposes read and write configuration views of the same SQL-specific configuration family.

members.name: ShardSetName
members.description: Configured name of the shard set.

members.name: DefaultShardId
members.description: Configured identifier of the default shard for the shard set.

members.name: ShardsConfigInternal
members.description: Interface-typed view of the configured shard connection entries.
members.notes: C# projection: IShardConnectionConfiguration[]; getter returns Shards.

members.name: Shards
members.notes: C# projection: SqlShardConnectionConfiguration[]; this is the concrete backing collection exposed through ShardsConfigInternal.

members.name: ReadConfigInternal
members.description: Interface-typed view of the read configuration.
members.notes: C# projection: IShardConnectionConfiguration; getter returns Read.

members.name: WriteConfigInternal
members.description: Interface-typed view of the write configuration.
members.notes: C# projection: IShardConnectionConfiguration; getter returns Write.

members.name: Read
members.description: SQL-specific read configuration. Unlike the shard-level ReadConnection/WriteConnection, this property has no default instance: it remains null until a configuration provider or caller explicitly assigns it.
members.notes: C# projection: SqlShardConnectionConfiguration, declared with no property initializer.

members.name: Write
members.description: SQL-specific write configuration. Unlike the shard-level ReadConnection/WriteConnection, this property has no default instance: it remains null until a configuration provider or caller explicitly assigns it.
members.notes: C# projection: SqlShardConnectionConfiguration, declared with no property initializer.

representations.CSharp: Public nested class SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionsConfiguration; the interface-typed ShardsConfigInternal, ReadConfigInternal, and WriteConfigInternal views are derived from the concrete Shards, Read, and Write properties. Read and Write carry no property initializer, so a newly constructed instance leaves them null, in contrast to SqlShardConnectionConfiguration's ReadConnection/WriteConnection, which each initialize to a new SqlConnectionConfiguration.
